name: Configure build systems and debug compiled software
description: Users asked for guidance on configuring build systems such as CMake and Makefiles, interpreting compiler and linker flags, and resolving errors related to cross-compilation and library integration. They also sought instructions on debugging compiled applications using tools like GDB and managing specific software toolchains in various development environments.
